title: efficiency: read_file on 63KB signals/index.md when read_file_range sufficed for scope enforcement
description: When recovering from the Phase 5a scope-enforcement rejection, the agent called read_file on the entire .moeb/signals/index.md (63KB, 197 lines), producing an overflow result saved to a temp file. grep_files had already identified the target row at line 192. read_file_range targeting lines 192-195 would have satisfied scope enforcement and avoided the overflow, reducing token waste and eliminating the temp-file indirection.
proposed_resolution: Update the Phase 5a signal index update instruction in spec.skill.md to use read_file_range targeting the grep-identified line after a scope-enforcement rejection, rather than full-file read_file. The Pre-Read Discipline sub-section being added by this spec's implementation should mention read_file_range as the preferred option when grep_files has already identified the target line.
